title: Separating the Generator from the Z Combinator
description: Factor out the fixed-point machinery into Y_machinery so it can turn any generator function into a recursive function.

steps.description: Extract factorial_generator as a pure function of rec that returns lambda n: 1 if n == 0 else n * rec(n - 1).
Define Y_machinery to take any generator gen and apply lambda self: gen(lambda n: self(self)(n)) to itself, then build factorial_v3 and print factorial_v3(7).

steps.question: What does Y_machinery(fib_generator) return without changing a single character of Y_machinery?
steps.answer: It returns a recursive Fibonacci function where rec(n-1) and rec(n-2) each invoke fib_generator again through self(self).

steps.description: Pass fib_generator to Y_machinery to create fib_v3 and compute the first ten Fibonacci numbers.
Watch factorial_v3(7) evaluate to 5040 using Y_machinery(factorial_generator).
